# Annotators and Annotation Guidelines {#sec-appendix-annotation}

| Humanitarian Category | Definition | Constructed Example |
|:--------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|
| Caution and advice | Warnings issued or lifted, and guidance and tips related to the disaster | Signal No. 3 na sa Quezon dahil kay Bagyong Henry. Stay indoors and charge your phones habang may kuryente pa. |
| Displaced people and evacuations | People who have relocated because of the disaster, even for a short time, including evacuations | Nag-evacuate na kami kagabi sa covered court ng barangay, almost 200 families na ang nandito dahil sa baha. |
| Infrastructure and utility damage | Damage to infrastructure such as buildings, houses, roads, bridges, power lines, communication poles, or vehicles | Bumagsak yung poste sa kanto namin, so wala pa ring power and signal since last night dahil sa bagyo. |
| Injured or dead people | People injured or killed by the disaster | Sad news, dalawa ang confirmed dead sa landslide sa Benguet dahil sa bagyo, tatlo pa ang injured. |
| Missing or found people | People missing or found because of the disaster | Still missing ang tito ko after the flood sa Marikina. Please message me kung may info kayo. |
| Not humanitarian | No information related to humanitarian aid | Grabe ang baha ng assignments this week, parang bagyo ang deadlines namin. |
| Other relevant information | Information useful for humanitarian aid that fits none of the other categories | As of 5 PM, passable pa ang NLEX pero mabagal ang traffic dahil sa baha sa ilang lanes. |
| Requests or urgent needs | Urgent needs for rescue, immediate help, or supplies such as food, water, clothing, money, medical supplies, or blood | Need po namin ng rescue dito sa Brgy. Tumana, hanggang second floor na ang baha at may kasama kaming senior. |
| Rescue, volunteering, or donation effort | Rescue, volunteering, or donation efforts, such as people being moved to safe places, people receiving medical aid or food, people in shelters, and donations of money or services | Our org is accepting donations para sa mga nasalanta ng bagyo. Drop-off ng relief goods sa gym until Sunday. |
| Sympathy and support | Prayers, thoughts, and emotional support | Praying for everyone sa Bicol na tinamaan ng bagyo. Ingat kayong lahat, stay strong. |

: Humanitarian Categories and Their Definitions {#tbl-categories tbl-colwidths="[22,39,39]"}

| Entity Type | Description | Constructed Example |
|:--------------|:--------------------------|:------------------|
| LOCATION | Geographical references | Marikina |
| DISASTER_TYPE | Named hazard or event type | Bagyong Henry |
| CASUALTY | Expressions of injury or death | dalawa ang confirmed dead |
| DISPLACED | Counts of evacuated or displaced people | almost 200 families |
| REQUEST | Expressed need for aid | Need po namin ng rescue |
| RESOURCE | Available aid supplies | relief goods |
| RESCUE | Active emergency operations | rescue team |
| ORGANIZATION | Named responding organizations | Philippine Red Cross |
| PERSON | Named individuals | Mayor Santos |
| NUMBER | Standalone numerical values | Signal No. 3 |

: Entity Types and Their Descriptions {#tbl-entity-types tbl-colwidths="[25,45,30]"}

| Role | Qualification | Task |
|:---------|:------------------|:------------------|
| Annotators (2) | Members of the research group who are fluent in Tagalog and English | Annotate the humanitarian category of every post and settle disagreements with each other by discussion |
| Adjudicator (1) | Person from outside the research group who works or does research in disaster management or crisis informatics | Decides the disagreements that remain after discussion and signs off on each batch |

: Qualifications and Tasks of the Annotators and the Adjudicator {#tbl-annotators tbl-colwidths="[18,41,41]"}

| Rule | Description |
|:-----|:----------------------------------------|
| One category | Each post is given exactly one humanitarian category, even when it fits more than one |
| Unrelated posts | A post that is unrelated to disasters, such as one that only mentions a disaster word, is kept and annotated as Not humanitarian |
| Requests | Requests or urgent needs covers posts that ask for rescue, supplies, or immediate help, and the urgency of a request is not rated |
| Batch log | A log is kept for each batch with its kappa, its date, whether a review was held, and the categories discussed, and the adjudicator signs it |

: Annotation Rules {#tbl-annotation-rules tbl-colwidths="[22,78]"}

| Setting | Value |
|:------------------|:----------------------------------------|
| Model | gliner_multi-v2.1 |
| Confidence threshold | 0.5, the default |
| Labels | The ten entity types, given as plain words such as location and disaster type |
| Input | The posts after the placeholders are applied, so that usernames are not marked as entities and GLiNER reads the same text as the models |
| Spans that cover a placeholder | Discarded |
